description:
Upload files to Notion.

Actions (required params -> optional):
- create (filename -> content_type, mode="single"|"multi_part", number_of_parts)
- send (file_upload_id, file_content -> part_number): base64-encoded content
- complete (file_upload_id)
- retrieve (file_upload_id)
- list (-> limit)

Max 20MB direct, multi-part for larger files.

file_content.description: Base64-encoded file content (for send). Must be valid base64: only A-Z, a-z, 0-9, +, /, = chars. Use Buffer.from(bytes).toString("base64") to encode.

part_number.description: Part number (for send in multi_part mode)

name: file_uploads
